scope: Only check_migration_compatibility, its ordering in _apply_migrations/_open_authorized_store, and the new compatibility regression module.

static_evidence.conclusion: Compatibility target is always the packaged _MIGRATIONS_DIR inventory. Exact main ledger shape and bounded rows are checked; names must form the exact sorted packaged prefix, with bounded non-null text metadata. Unknown/future, gaps, duplicates and malformed ledger shapes fail closed.

An unversioned empty database is distinguished from populated unclassified data; the literal sqlite_ GLOB excludes only SQLite-internal names, so sqliteX user objects are not silently treated as internal.

Admission runs before CREATE TABLE or migration script execution in the canonical writer factory. Only read-check SQLite errors are translated; injected migration-body failures keep their original rollback/exception path and failed construction closes the connection.

Tests exercise actual writer refusals for unknown/gapped/unversioned stores with byte and directory preservation; fresh/prefix/complete packaged-ledger facts; normal read-only URI without migration; malformed/duplicate/empty-populated ledgers. Custom script directory is used only to form an actual packaged first-migration prefix.

limits: No tests, compilation, imports, DB, Git, process, native, provider or network operations performed by reviewer; only this new outside-Git artifact is written.
Root-reported RED/GREEN execution is not independently executed or given qualification credit here.

This is a migration-name ledger compatibility check, not historical SQL checksum/schema attestation, cross-store profile compatibility, serialized multi-version upgrade proof, CLI/restore behavior, old-7d downgrade proof or financial authority.
No full profile, native, PLAT08 requirement, H01 or Master acceptance/completion claim.
